subject: Medford Community Chorale Spring Concert
overview: The Medford Community Chorale and Youth and Young Adult Chorus presented their 10th live spring concert, titled "You're the Inspiration," featuring popular, folk, musical theater, and patriotic selections. Proceeds from the concert program were designated for donation to the Medford Youth Center.

items.title: Welcome and Opening Remarks
items.summary: The director welcomed the audience to the chorale's 10th live concert and announced that program proceeds would benefit the Medford Youth Center.

items.title: Medford Community Chorale First Set
items.summary: The full chorale performed an opening set of songs including "You're the Inspiration," "Shenandoah," a medley from Hair, "For Good," and "You Raise Me Up."

items.title: Youth and Young Adult Chorus Set
items.summary: The Youth and Young Adult Chorus took the stage to perform "Here Comes the Sun," "Somewhere Out There," "California Dreamin'," "Take Me Home, Country Roads," and "Swinging on a Star."

items.title: Joint Chorus Performances
items.summary: Both chorus groups combined to perform "I Believe" alongside a medley of "Heal the World" and "We Are the World."

items.title: Full Chorus Second Set
items.summary: The chorale returned to perform "One Voice," "Thank You for the Music," "What a Wonderful World," "The Greatest Love of All," and "New York, New York."

items.title: Recognitions, Raffles, and Closing Acknowledggments
items.summary: Chorale members presented tokens of appreciation to the director and accompanist, followed by raffle winner drawings and expressions of gratitude to supporters.

items.title: Concert Finale
items.summary: The chorale and audience concluded the evening with a joint sing-along performance of "God Bless America."
